resources.name: Alabama Lawyer Assistance Program (ALAP)
resources.confidential: Anonymity preserved; not disclosed to other departments within the state bar
resources.description: Alabama State Bar program: confidential help for law students, lawyers, and judges facing mental health, substance use, cognitive impairment, stress, or burnout — peer support, mentorship, referrals to vetted providers, and monitoring.

resources.name: Alabama Lawyer Assistance Foundation (ALAF)
resources.confidential: Operates in support of the confidential ALAP program
resources.cost: Revolving loan fund — loans paid to treatment providers, repaid once the lawyer recovers
resources.description: 501(c)(3) revolving loan fund (distinct from the Alabama Law Foundation) that funds addiction/mental-health treatment for AL lawyers, judges, and law students who cannot pay; works alongside ALAP. Verified on its dedicated alabar.org page.

resources.name: Lawyers' Assistance Committee (LAC)

phones.label: Alaska Bar Association (LAC)
phones.hoursNote: Bar general office line; hours not stated

resources.description: Alaska Bar Association committee providing education, confidential assistance, and referrals (with a vetted provider list) for members, families, and colleagues affected by mental health or substance-use issues.

resources.name: Member Assistance Program (MAP)
resources.confidential: Confidential under Arizona Supreme Court rule (LAP privilege / Rule 1.6)
resources.description: State Bar of Arizona peer-support wellness program: trained volunteer lawyers support lawyers, judges, law students, and families facing addiction, mental-health challenges, stress, or work/life issues; also CLE and a monthly support group.

resources.name: Arkansas Judges and Lawyers Assistance Program (JLAP)
resources.confidential: Confidential and privileged under Arkansas JLAP Rule 10
resources.description: Statewide program (a committee of the Arkansas Supreme Court, est. 2000) providing free confidential mental-health, addiction, stress, and grief services to Arkansas judges, lawyers, law students/applicants, and their adult family members.

resources.name: Colorado Lawyer Assistance Program (COLAP)
resources.confidential: Privileged; cannot be used in disciplinary proceedings
resources.description: Free, confidential, independent program of the Colorado Supreme Court for judges, lawyers, and law students — well-being consultations, tailored referrals, and voluntary monitoring for stress, mental health, and substance use.

resources.name: Colorado Lawyers Helping Lawyers (CLHL)
resources.description: Court-approved nonprofit peer-assistance program: free confidential peer-support meetings, education, and referrals for lawyers and law students facing substance use, mental health, or well-being issues.

resources.name: The Waterman Fund
resources.confidential: Applicant and award information kept confidential
resources.description: Charitable trust (Denver Bar Association) providing confidential financial assistance to aged, infirm, or incapacitated Colorado lawyers in good standing who have practiced in Colorado at least 10 years.

resources.name: Colorado Crisis Services (referred crisis line)
resources.description: Statewide 24/7 crisis line that COLAP and CLHL direct lawyers to for urgent mental-health/suicide crises. Not lawyer-specific; included as the referred crisis line. Own page not loaded this session.

resources.name: Lawyers Concerned for Lawyers — Connecticut, Inc. (LCL-CT)
resources.operator: Lawyers Concerned for Lawyers — Connecticut, Inc.
resources.confidential: Confidential and protected under Conn. Gen. Stat. §51-81d(a)
resources.description: Independent Connecticut nonprofit (not affiliated with the bar or disciplinary bodies) providing free, anonymous crisis intervention, mental-health evaluation, peer-support groups, and referrals for lawyers, judges, and law students.

resources.name: Delaware Lawyers Assistance Program (DE-LAP)

phones.label: DE-LAP office / Executive Director
phones.hoursNote: Hours not stated; toll-free 877-243-3527 seen in search but not confirmed on a primary page

resources.confidential: Strictly confidential; committee relationship treated as attorney-client privileged
resources.description: Delaware State Bar Association program: a confidential, free, non-disciplinary path for judges and lawyers facing substance use or mental/physical health problems (depression, stress, gambling) to get help. Verified via the DSBA-hosted page (de-lap.org served a mismatched TLS cert).

resources.name: D.C. Bar Lawyer Assistance Program (LAP)

phones.label: Confidential LAP line
phones.hoursNote: Confidential intake line; not an emergency service (crises → 911 or 988)

resources.description: Free, confidential program for D.C. Bar members, judges, and District law students: clinical assessment, short-term counseling (up to 12 sessions), referrals, monitoring, peer mentors, support groups, and well-being education.

resources.name: Florida Lawyers Assistance, Inc. (FLA)
resources.operator: Florida Lawyers Assistance, Inc. (contracted by The Florida Bar)

phones.label: Toll-free hotline
phones.hoursNote: 24-hour claim appears only in secondary sources; not confirmed on FLA's own page

resources.confidential: Confidentiality protected by contract with The Florida Bar and by Bar Rule 3-7.1(j) / Fla. Stat. 397.482-486
resources.cost: Free intake; support-group facilitators paid a nominal fee by participants
resources.description: Independent nonprofit (est. 1986 under the Florida Supreme Court mandate), contracted and funded by The Florida Bar, that confidentially helps lawyers, judges, and law students affected by substance use, mental health, or cognitive impairment; 300+ volunteers and 30+ weekly support groups.

resources.name: Florida Lawyers Helpline
resources.operator: CuraLinc Health Care (member benefit of The Florida Bar)
resources.cost: Free — up to five counseling sessions per year
resources.description: EAP-style member benefit of The Florida Bar operated by CuraLinc Health Care: 24/7/365 access to counselors and therapists (in-person or teletherapy), up to five free sessions annually.

resources.name: Lawyer Assistance Program (LAP)
resources.operator: State Bar of Georgia (administered by CuraLinc/SupportLinc)

phones.label: LAP confidential hotline
phones.hoursNote: Staffed by trained counselors 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

resources.confidential: Confidential; delivered via third-party administrator, not reported to the Bar
resources.cost: Free; six prepaid clinical sessions per calendar year
resources.description: State Bar of Georgia program delivered through SupportLinc (CuraLinc Healthcare): a 24/7 hotline, six prepaid counseling sessions/year, and a teletherapy portal for stress, anxiety, depression, substance use, and family/workplace issues.

resources.name: Lawyers Helping Lawyers (Georgia peer program)
resources.operator: Lawyer Assistance Committee, State Bar of Georgia
resources.confidential: Confidential peer-to-peer program (disclosures held in an encrypted database)
resources.description: Confidential volunteer peer-support program of the State Bar of Georgia's Lawyer Assistance Committee, pairing a member with a fellow Bar member via an online matching database. Verified on georgialhl.org.

resources.name: Attorneys and Judges Assistance Program (AAP)

phones.label: AAP office (Honolulu)
phones.hoursNote: Hours not stated on the official page

phones.label: Neighbor Islands toll-free
phones.hoursNote: Routing/access line; 24/7 not stated on loaded pages

resources.confidential: Confidential and privileged under Hawaii Supreme Court Rule 16.6
resources.description: Hawaii's statewide program (a Hawaii Supreme Court program under Rule 16) providing confidential assistance to attorneys, judges, and law students facing impairment affecting professional performance — education, guidance, emotional support, and monitoring.

resources.name: Idaho Lawyer Assistance Program (LAP)
resources.operator: Idaho State Bar (clinical services by Southworth Associates)

phones.label: Program Coordinator (Ben Seymour, CADC)
phones.hoursNote: Direct coordinator line; hours not stated

resources.confidential: 100% confidential; not reported to the Idaho State Bar
resources.description: Idaho State Bar program with clinical/crisis services delivered by Southworth Associates International: a 24/7 confidential hotline, consulting, referrals, interventions, monitoring, and family support for substance use and mental health.
